_about: The owner's own products for the Business catalog, loaded by scripts/business/seed-products.py. Facts come from docs/business/products/<slug>.md, which lists the sources. Prices are not set: every offer is 'quote' until the owner confirms a price. The target_profile block becomes each product's target customer profile (PUT /api/v1/business/pipeline/products/{id}/target); '-' means unknown.

product.name: ANUM OS
product.summary: A multi-tenant AI work operating system: agents with approval gates, tasks, memory and knowledge, files, automations, reports, an internal sales desk, email, WhatsApp, calls and commerce connectors, on web, Flutter mobile and desktop. Tenant isolation through PostgreSQL row-level security, Keycloak sign-in, audit trail. Sold first as an assisted team pilot; SaaS plans only after proof (roadmap 2.3).
integrations: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube

deliverables: One isolated organization and team workspace on ANUM OS
Role permissions, approvals and audit log switched on
Up to two department assistants configured from the owner's documents
One automation or report built around the customer's chosen workflow
limitations: Assisted pilot only: public SaaS plans are not offered yet (roadmap 2.3)
Model, messaging, storage and telephony usage billed separately with caps
Provider accounts (WhatsApp, Twilio, Brevo, store channels) are the customer's own
No unlimited AI usage; no 24/7 support promise
offer.notes: Price: '-' (owner to confirm). Recommendation: quote the pilot from the roadmap pricing formula (labor hours x internal hourly cost + verified external costs + contingency + profit) and set SaaS prices only after 5 to 10 buyer interviews and 2 to 3 paid pilots (roadmap 2.3). Cost assumptions are zero until the owner enters them.

industries: Operations teams with many repeated tasks
trigger_events: Team adopting AI tools without approvals or audit
Customer messages spread across WhatsApp and email
disqualifiers: Needs unattended autonomous actions without approvals
Requires on-premises or data residency the owner cannot provide yet
Wants a fixed price for unlimited AI usage

product.name: Tyre Pulse
product.summary: Fleet, tyre, inspection, workshop, accident and reporting platform for plant, machinery and vehicle (PMV) operations. Web console for office and managers; Flutter mobile app for inspectors that works offline, in English, Arabic and Urdu. Smart Excel and CSV importer with data quality checks, tyre records, inspections, accidents and insurance claims with recovery, maintenance and work orders, stock and procurement, analytics, executive reports, row-level security per role. Website www.tyrepulse.app.
integrations: Excel and CSV import (xlsx, xls, ods, csv, tsv)

deliverables: 30-day pilot on a limited fleet dataset imported from the customer's spreadsheets
Data quality report from the importer (missing values, bad dates, duplicates)
Tyre, replacement and cost report for the pilot fleet
Inspector app set up for the pilot site, offline capable
One review meeting with findings and next steps
limitations: Only functions actually tested in the pilot are promised
Data migration beyond the pilot dataset and integrations are quoted separately
Plan after the pilot (Solo, Team, Professional, Enterprise) quoted by fleet size, users, modules, countries and integrations
offer.notes: Price: '-' (owner to confirm). Recommendation: the roadmap's test price hypothesis for this pilot is SAR 750 to 1,500 (roadmap 2.2, not market research). The Tyre Pulse website quotes plans on request, never a published figure. Cost assumptions are zero until the owner enters them.

target_profile.company_size: Fleets of about 50 or more vehicles and machines, one or more sites
trigger_events: Rising tyre spend or tyre failures
Accident and insurance claims tracked on paper
New project or site mobilising a fleet
Audit or client asking for inspection proof
disqualifiers: Already locked into an enterprise fleet suite with a long contract
No one able to share tyre or fleet data for the pilot

product.name: VoiceQuote
product.summary: Quotation tool for service businesses with slow quote turnaround (roadmap 2.1). Domain easyvoicequote.com. Verified features are not documented in this repository; the pilot scope comes from roadmap 2.2: configured catalog subset, quote approval and export, training. Owner to confirm the feature list.

deliverables: Configured catalog subset for the customer's services
limitations: Catalog size, quote accuracy and external integrations explicitly bounded in the scope
Features limited to what the owner has verified (see the product page)
offer.notes: Price: '-' (owner to confirm). Recommendation: quote after scoping, as roadmap 2.2 says, using the pricing formula. Maturity is set to 'idea' only because it is not verified here: owner to set it.

trigger_events: Losing jobs because quotes go out late

product.name: Anum360 Store
